import numpy as np

                           aggfunc='first')

print("\nPivot columns:", pivot_df.columns.tolist())
print("\nPivot head:")

print("\nImputed X shape:", X_imputed.shape)
print("Missing values after imputation:", np.isnan(X_imputed).sum())

print("\nScaled X shape:", X_scaled.shape)

print("\nCluster distribution:", np.bincount(cluster_labels))
